categories.name: Footwear
categories.blurb: Trainers built for the long way

products.name: Aurora Wool Overcoat
products.description: A long, softly structured overcoat in double-faced Italian wool. Fully canvassed shoulders, horn buttons and a deep welt pocket set. Cut to layer cleanly over tailoring or knitwear.

products.name: Sienna Linen Blazer
products.description: An unstructured blazer cut from washed Belgian linen, with natural horn buttons and patch pockets. Creases beautifully and travels without a bag.

products.name: Vela Silk Wrap Dress
products.description: Cut on the bias from 100% mulberry silk so it falls rather than hangs. Comes with a self-tie belt and a subtle sheen that shifts with the light.

products.name: Northwind Cable Knit
products.description: A heavy 7-gauge merino crewneck, hand-framed cable panels. Warm enough for the cold months, structured enough to wear on its own.

products.name: Atlas Oxford Shirt
products.description: Garment-washed oxford cotton with a soft hand and a slightly relaxed cut. Mother-of-pearl buttons, single patch pocket, split back yoke.

products.name: Harbor Selvedge Denim
products.description: 13.5oz unsanforised selvedge denim from Okayama, woven on a shuttle loom. Expect beautiful fading. Cut straight with a mid rise.

products.name: Pico Rain Slicker
products.description: A packable kids rain slicker with fully taped seams and a fleece-lined collar. Folds into its own pocket and survives a suitcase.

products.name: Wren Knit Cardigan
products.description: Lofty organic cotton cardigan with corozo nut buttons. Machine washable, which for a knit this size is a genuine rarity.

products.name: Meridian Leather Tote
products.description: A structured tote in vegetable-tanned leather that patinas beautifully. Fits a 15-inch laptop in a suspended sleeve. 38cm wide, 30cm tall.

products.name: Solstice Shades
products.description: Acetate frames with polarised UV400 lenses and a spring hinge. Comes with a hard case and a microfibre cloth.

products.name: Cascade Trail Runner
products.description: A trail shoe with a nylon rock plate and 4mm multidirectional lugs. 268g per shoe in a size 8. Runs true to size with a roomy toe box.

products.name: Dockside Deck Sneaker
products.description: A vulcanised rubber-soled deck sneaker in 12oz organic canvas. Removable cork footbed, reinforced toe box, machine washable.
